Indian stock market news today · Ripple's top 9 stories · 7 Nov 2026
Indian markets are shut today; the watchlist and colour codes are for the next session, Monday 9 Nov.

1. Asian chip stocks crash on Friday: Kospi halted after an 8% fall, Nikkei drops about 6%, SK Hynix falls 11.7% — Yahoo Finance (Fox Business)
2. Sensex and Nifty post their best week since February 2021 as a seven-session rally lifts the Nifty above 25,000 — Business Standard
3. Foreign investors buy a record ₹45,960 crore of Indian shares in a week as domestic funds sell a record ₹24,197 crore — Business Standard
4. US payrolls jump 165,000 in October, nearly triple forecasts, lifting December Fed hike odds to about 77–85% — Yahoo Finance (Reuters)
5. Oil posts its biggest weekly drop since 2022 on Iran peace hopes, with Brent settling flat at $98.32 — Rigzone (Bloomberg)
6. Wall Street steadies on Friday: Nasdaq gains 1.1% as AMD jumps 11%, but the S&P 500 still loses 2.7% for the week — Yahoo Finance (AP)
7. Rupee logs its biggest one-day gain since 12 October, closing at about 93.9 per dollar — IANS
8. Hindalco's profit jumps 59% to ₹7,533 crore as revenue rises 39% to ₹91,708 crore — Kotak Neo
9. Tata Steel reports delayed September-quarter results on Saturday, alongside Divi's Labs, Tata Chemicals and HBL Engineering — PSU Connect

Swipe for each story's numbers, tone and who moves Monday: green = the news points up, red = the news points down, grey = watch. Summaries of published reports; sources named on each card. Not investment advice.
